authorship: Reviewer did not author this compiler patch or original regression.

judgments.bugReproduced: Prior local keepSeparate lookup only sees local members within a shared-name block. A hard separation through an off-block merged member still separates the entire canonical pair, so scheduling that pair again is a real bug.
judgments.correctPruning: The draft maps each final resolver keepSeparate edge through complete canonical ownership once. It then suppresses exactly those canonical pairs. It neither infers separation transitively nor alters resolver merges/conflict enforcement.
judgments.performance: Canonical separation Set is constructed once per unresolvedCandidateState invocation, O(number of separations), outside all blocks and pair loops. Each block-pair lookup is constant expected time.
judgments.callerCompleteness: Both exact000d compiler and SDK buildDossiers invoke resolvePeopleClusters on complete corpus.localPeople; both populate localMap/canonicalByLocal from every resolved cluster member. SDK target chapter and shard filters happen after unresolvedCandidateState. loadValidatedResolutionDocuments and resolver reject unknown local people, so no legitimate qualification-filter missing-owner path is introduced.
judgments.failFast: Malformed separator key or absent local owner throws even for empty candidates, rather than silently suppressing or opening an unknown pair. Normal resolver guarantees nonempty valid canonical ownership values.
judgments.possibleSameAs: Resolver already converts complete possibleSameAs groups to canonical pair keys. Draft leaves that path and lookup unchanged.
judgments.curation: Only the final resolver keepSeparate Set is converted, so normal curated override semantics and explicit hard constraints are preserved.
judgments.primaryWorkspace: Primary compiler and SDK already differ from000d; this review targeted exact immutable Git base plus draft. Reviewer performed no writes to primary/candidate code and no adoption.

tests.firstAttemptNote: Initial ad-hoc fixture omitted mentions metadata required by buildResolutionCandidates; corrected fixture includes mentions and promptVersion. No production failure was inferred from that fixture error.
